We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It's how we've contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services and our open-access model we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG's ticker symbol is LSEG.

Role Purpose

As the DataOps Lead within Data Solutions Capital Markets Data Factory (CMDF), you will lead the delivery of scalable, resilient data operations and governance frameworks. Your mission is to design and implement solutions that maintain and enhance data quality, maximize automation, and foster multi-functional collaboration.

You will focus on data lineage, data quality controls, and metadata management, ensuring transparency, accuracy, and operational resilience across critical datasetsparticularly within Equities (EQ) and Foreign Exchange (FX) exchange venues. Additionally, you will partner with stakeholders across Capital Markets to improve documentation (e.g. data dictionary), operational processes, reduce risk, strengthen the data foundation, and unlock new value from data assets (e.g. integration with Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent configuration and semantic model creation).

This role involves mentoring and managing Data Analysts, promoting engineering excellence, and collaborating with Data Architects and technical leads to evolve architecture, standards, and processes. Your impact will be seen in delivering consistent, high-quality data solutions that accelerate delivery timelines, strengthen governance, and support strategic business and regulatory initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Data Lifecycle Management: Participate and oversee end-to-end data operationscollection, cleaning, validation, and deliveryensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Governance & Quality: Implement robust data lineage, quality controls, and metadata management frameworks.
Incident Management: Manage and is part of 2L support for data problems, perform root cause analysis, tracking the implemention of long-term fixes. Track team progress by and KPI using key metrics (e.g. resolution times, recurring issues, satisfaction scores) to identify trends, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and optimize support processes.
Automation & Efficiency: Drive automation across data operation workflows, optimize processes, and enforce best practices.
Team Leadership: Mentor and lead DataOps team members, fostering accountability and professional growth.
Collaboration: Work closely with Data Architects, engineers, and business teams to align technical solutions with strategic goals.
Agile Delivery: Oversee backlog management, and Jira governance for timely execution.
Documentation & Training: Maintain data catalogues, dictionaries, and lineage; facilitate user training for self-service data access.

Essential Skills & Experience

Advanced SQL and solid understanding of Data Warehouse principles.
Expertise in ETL/ELT, data lakes, and data warehousing concepts.
Proficiency in Python for analytics, automation, and statistical analysis.
Hands-on experience with RDBMS (Snowflake preferred).
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS Cloud.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Experience implementing data quality controls and governance frameworks.
Skilled in manual and automated testing techniques.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.
Effective communication skills to collaborate with multi-functional teams and convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience in Capital Markets, particularly Equities and FX datasets.
Knowledge of regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiFID II, GDPR).
Familiarity with data cataloguing tools and metadata management.

Ready to contribute to a culture that champions innovation, diversity, and excellence LSEG is the place for you. Apply now and become an integral part of a team that values your skills. Let's craft the future togetheryour journey starts here!

Our people

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. Evaluate Emerging Tech: Continuously assess new DevOps tools and technologies (service mesh, GitOps, AI-driven automation) and integrate them where they add value.
Mentor & Influence: Guide and coach DevOps engineers, fostering a culture of automation, learning, and operational excellence. Act as a thought leader for DevOps across the organization.
Technologies You'll Work With
Cloud & Infra: AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, Helm, CloudFormation.
CI/CD & DevOps: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker, Kubernetes.
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, ELK stack, Grafana, CloudWatch.
Security & Governance: DevSecOps practices, compliance (GDPR, PCI DSS, PSD2).
Collaboration Tools: Jira, Confluence, Git-based workflows (GitLab/GitHub).

Qualifications
Extensive DevOps & IT Experience: 15+ years in IT, including 8+ years in DevOps and 3+ years in an architect-level role. Proven success in designing DevOps solutions for complex, distributed systems.
Cloud Platform Mastery: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure, and GCP, with hands-on experience in hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
Infrastructure-as-Code Skills: Strong proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible, with experience in Helm charts for Kubernetes workloads.
CI/CD Expertise: Solid track record with Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, and other modern CI/CD tools. You can design and optimize pipelines for security, speed, and reliability.
Containerization & Orchestration: Expert in Docker and Kubernetes, with a deep understanding of scaling, clustering, and workload distribution.
Security & Networking Knowledge: Solid foundation in networking, system administration, and security hardening across cloud-native platforms.
Agile & DevSecOps Mindset: Experience working in Agile environments, embedding DevOps practices into development lifecycles, and adopting DevSecOps approaches.
Leadership & Collaboration: Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Capable of influencing teams, driving alignment, and mentoring engineers.
Cloud and DevOps certifications (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Expert, CKA/CKAD).
Proven experience deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes, including Helm-based packaging and rollout.
Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd) and microservices-based deployments.

Position Summary

Informatica DG/DQ Sr. Data Engineer, DT-US PxE DnA

The Informatica DG/DQ Sr. Data Engineer is an integral part of the Data Quality and Data Governance engineering team focused on implementing data quality and governance solutions as part of US Data Strategy initiative. Requires expertise in data integration, data quality, data governance, and experience with Informatica platform solutions.

Work you will do This is a unique opportunity to be a part of growing data operations and enterprise controls team that works on new and existing high-end data management platforms within Deloitte.You will be responsible for leading, development, implementation, and support of Informatica solutions to support organizational data quality and data governance capabilities in a complex hybrid, multi-cloud environment.Responsibilities include:

Understanding the business rules and sourcing data from multiple source systems
Plan and lead Data Quality & Data Governance requirement analysis sessions with business users
Data Profiling and Analysis: Conduct data profiling to understand data patterns, anomalies, and quality issues. Analyze data quality metrics and identify areas for improvement.
Data Quality Rule Development: Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and transformations using Informatica Data Quality (IDQ) tools. Create reusable data quality rules and mappings to ensure consistency across different data sources.
Data Cleansing and Standardization: Design and execute data cleansing processes to correct and standardize data. Implement data enrichment techniques to enhance data quality.
Data Quality Monitoring and Reporting: Set up data quality monitoring dashboards and reports to track data quality metrics. Generate regular data quality reports and present findings to stakeholders.
Collaboration with Stakeholders: Work closely with business analysts, data stewards, and other stakeholders to understand data quality requirements. Collaborate with IT teams to integrate data quality solutions into existing data workflows.
Issue Resolution and Root Cause Analysis: Identify and resolve data quality issues in a timely manner. Perform root cause analysis to prevent recurring data quality problems.
Documentation and Best Practices: Document data quality processes, rules, and standards. Develop and maintain best practices for data quality management.
Data Governance Framework Implementation: Design and implement data governance frameworks using Informatica CDGC and CDMP (Marketplace). Develop policies, procedures, and standards for data governance.
Metadata Management: Utilize Informatica Metadata Manager to capture, manage, and analyze metadata. Ensure metadata is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Data Lineage and Impact Analysis: Implement data lineage tracking to understand data flow across systems. Conduct impact analysis to assess the effects of changes in data sources or processes.
Data Cataloging and Discovery: Use Informatica CDGC to create and maintain a comprehensive data catalog. Facilitate data discovery and access for business users.
Demonstrated business acumen and the ability to apply technology solutions to solve business problems.
Automated/Scheduled the cloud jobs to run daily with email notifications for any failures and Timeout errors Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Business Information Systems or MCA or equivalent degree.
